sources.title: PEFT : Infrastructure for AI for Science | SciencePedia
sources.snippet: PEFT provides an essential AI for Science infrastructure for efficient model adaptation, offering machine-readable and one-click-ready implementations of methods like LoRA, QLoRA, and Prefix Tuning. These out-of-the-box capabilities enable AI Agents to programmatically call and apply optimal fine-tuning strategies, rapidly specializing large pre-trained models for diverse scientific tasks ...
